info.name: Online C Compiler API & Execution Sandbox
info.description:
Official API collection for [onlineccompiler.com](https://onlineccompiler.com/) - High-performance GCC C compilation, execution sandbox, and memory architecture visualizer.

### Official Web Portals
- **English**: [https://onlineccompiler.com/](https://onlineccompiler.com/)
- **Español**: [https://onlineccompiler.com/es/](https://onlineccompiler.com/es/)
- **Português**: [https://onlineccompiler.com/pt/](https://onlineccompiler.com/pt/)
- **Deutsch**: [https://onlineccompiler.com/de/](https://onlineccompiler.com/de/)
- **Français**: [https://onlineccompiler.com/fr/](https://onlineccompiler.com/fr/)

### Open-Source Suite
- GitHub: [MoMahdideveloper/online-c-compiler-suite](https://github.com/MoMahdideveloper/online-c-compiler-suite)

request.description:
Submits C source code to the GCC cloud backend and receives stdout, stderr, executionTime, exitCode, and engine diagnostics.

Learn more at [https://onlineccompiler.com/](https://onlineccompiler.com/)
Executes dynamic memory allocation (`malloc`/`free`) and outputs pointer addresses matching the visualizer at [https://onlineccompiler.com/](https://onlineccompiler.com/).
